Just at that moment, one of the ship’s officers enters, distracting 
the thing—allowing you to get away! The officer, his hair standing 
on end, wisely turns on his heels and runs with you down the 
hall to safety.
The captain has you guarded for the rest of the trip; no sign 
of your attackers are found. Y ou have no more ship activities 
selections. Mark off the remaining days and disembark at Athens 
at 173, or Alexandria at 195 (if that port is your destination).
(155)
